scene: The robot mime bows and points out three exits.
picture: Inside the circus exit plaza, a yellow bicycle rickshaw waits on the far left. The silver robot mime stands left of centre, gesturing. The tall Latino man in poncho, hat, and guitar stands centre. Up high hangs a brass book cart lift. A purple night bus idles on the far right.
